angleDeg.description: Chamfer angle relative to reference face; required only for distanceAngle

flipDirection.description: Use the other adjacent support face

referenceFaceId.description: Optional current source face index incident to every selected edge; default first adjacent face in current topology order

sharedFaces.description: With at least two faceIds, process only their common sharp edges; omitted/false preserves historical face-boundary scope

allEdges.description: Explicitly process every sharp edge of the body

selectionTokenSupport.phases: Validate user params with phase=input and selectionToken, resolve against current snapshot, then validate complete params with phase=resolved.

editRule: On edit, patch edgeIds or faceIds selects that exact current topology scope and removes the other scope. Patch allEdges=true selects all body edges. Supplying multiple scopes in one patch conflicts. Amount is merged from existing params.
coordinateConvention: faceId, faceIds and edgeIds are zero-based indices of the CURRENT referenced body. body.faceCount/edgeCount define the range. Use current selectedTopology (when available) to identify user-picked face/edge/point. queryGeometry or measure returns exact BRep face type and measures. Counts alone do not identify spatial meaning. Do not guess face orientation. Rebuild may renumber topology; do not reuse IDs across revisions without reinspection. Unified logo accepts one exact planar or supported curved face; faceHole and faceExtrude require planar faces. Choose exactly one scope: edgeIds, faceIds, or allEdges=true. sharedFaces:true selects their common sharp edges. Legacy/omitted mode is equalDistance. twoDistances requires distance2; distanceAngle requires angleDeg in (0,90), radians are converted only at kernel call. Opposite mode fields are rejected; equalDistance forbids asymmetric options. Asymmetric distance is on referenceFaceId, or first adjacent current source face; flipDirection uses the other face. Optional explicit reference face must touch every selected edge. Tangent/periodic seams and degenerate edges are excluded. Failure preserves source, never reduces dimensions. getState().bodies[].blendReport returns mode, processed/skipped edges and resolved supportFaces for asymmetric modes.

selectionGuide.chooseWhen: 直线切角，支持等距/双距/角度；不是弧形圆角。

alternatives.chooseWhen: 按精确 R 对选边、面边界或整件尖边倒圆。
对等径直圆杆的垂直 T 接头设置独立三维 R；与日字扣定 R 共用滚球算法。不是任意面圆角，不支持异径、斜交或 X 接头。
按明确 R 一次处理整件所有尖边；失败不自动缩小或跳过目标。
统一圆润入口，区分边缘与杆件端头；先读识别结果及明确范围。
按杆件截面重建自由端头；不等于普通固定 R 倒圆。
既有自动打磨操作，选边及半径策略以当前合同为准，不等同端头重建。
多相邻面联合处理公共尖缝，生成真实过渡面。
只探测指定范围内可行半径并返回证据；不提交倒圆。
只读检查当前倒圆选择/范围；不是执行或自动缩小半径。
把指定平面面加厚成带边缘圆角的牌体。
向目标加球形/椭球形凸点并处理接缝；不是高度图整体浮雕。
